python3 -c "
import re
PARSE_RE = re.compile(r'''({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})''')

# Check brace counts in various parts
test_cases = [
    'hello {',
    '} hello', 
    '{world',
    'world}',
    '{{{',
    '{foo}}',
    'hel{lo',  # brace in middle
]

for tc in test_cases:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(tc)
    print(f'{tc!r:25}')
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if part:
            opens = part.count('{')
            closes = part.count('}')
            print(f'  Part {i}: {part!r} -> opens={opens}, closes={closes}, diff={opens-closes}')
"
